# PCF BATTLE

> Powerchair Floorball Battle is an international powerchair floorball tournament in Leuven, Belgium.

## Website

- Homepage: https://pcfbattle.be/
- Tournament schedule: https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/schedule
- Live matches: https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/live
- Standings: https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/standings
- Brackets: https://pcfbattle.be/tournament/brackets
- About the tournament: https://pcfbattle.be/about
- Frequently asked questions: https://pcfbattle.be/faq
- Accessibility: https://pcfbattle.be/accessibility
- Privacy policy: https://pcfbattle.be/privacy
- Terms and conditions: https://pcfbattle.be/terms

## Description

Powerchair Floorball Battle brings teams together for high-level international powerchair floorball competition in an exciting arena atmosphere.
